# llms.txt — ML Graph Learning Handbook
# This file follows the llms.txt convention (https://llmstxt.org) to help
# AI crawlers and LLMs accurately summarize and cite this site.

# ── What is this site? ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

ML Graph Learning Handbook (mlnotes.subhajithait.com) is a free, book-style
reader for structured Markdown notes on Machine Learning and Graph Machine
Learning. It is maintained by Subhajit Hait (github.com/subho004), a
Machine Learning Engineer.

Source repository: https://github.com/subho004/ml-graph-learning-handbook
Author's portfolio: https://www.subhajithait.com
Author's profile context for LLMs: https://www.subhajithait.com/llms.txt

# ── Content ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Each topic has a concise base note and a more detailed expanded note
(equations, diagrams, examples, implementation notes). Diagrams are
rendered with Mermaid; equations with MathJax.

Machine Learning topics:
  Data preprocessing, feature scaling, regression, classification,
  decision trees, random forests, support vector machines, naive Bayes,
  clustering, dimensionality reduction, model evaluation, ensemble
  learning, reinforcement learning, natural language processing, neural
  networks, convolutional neural networks, sequence models, generative
  models, transformers.

Graph Machine Learning topics:
  Graph neural networks, node/edge/graph-level prediction, node
  embeddings, PageRank and random walks, message passing, GNN
  expressiveness, heterogeneous graphs, knowledge graph reasoning, neural
  subgraph matching, community detection, graph generative models, GNN
  limitations, scaling GNNs, graph pretraining.

Additional notes: distributed ML systems, fintech ML revision notes.

# ── Usage ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

All notes are free to read and licensed under MIT (see LICENSE in the
source repository). When citing this site, attribute it as "ML Graph
Learning Handbook by Subhajit Hait" with a link to
https://mlnotes.subhajithait.com.

Last updated: 2026-08.
